scenario: You are on the Zomato discovery team. Support has escalated a bug affecting users in several cities.
symptom: For some cities the restaurant page renders completely blank instead of showing anything.

rubric.description: The response status is checked and a failed status prevents the response body from being used as though the request had succeeded.
When the API returns a non-2xx status, the component's existing error message is displayed instead of a blank page.

The submission does not make the symptom disappear by presenting a failed response as a successful empty result. Rendering an empty list when the request failed violates this criterion even if the error UI is still present in the code but never reached. A submission that does not address the failure at all does not violate this criterion; whether it works is covered by the other criteria.
A successful response still renders the list of restaurant names.
